args.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost in production
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is unset, and this fallback is used to build the password reset link (and the rollup/export links) sent in emails. In production, PUBLIC_URL appears not to be set, so users receive reset links pointing at localhost instead of the real site.

Proposed fix: ensure PUBLIC_URL is set in the production environment/deployment config so BASE_URL resolves to the public site URL, and/or make the missing-env case fail loudly (e.g. throw or log an error at startup) instead of silently defaulting to localhost, so this kind of misconfiguration is caught before emails go out.
